description: South Australian council dog or cat records per 1,000 residents, 2025. Shared controls select the species, region and council; drag to pan, hold Shift and scroll to zoom, or hover for values.

signals.name: colorSurface
signals.description: Colour: white, the colour of the card each chart sits on. This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-surface in css/style.css.

signals.name: colorPetDogs
signals.description: Colour: the colour for dogs (amber). This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-pet-dogs in css/style.css.

signals.name: fontHeading
signals.description: Font: the fancy title font (DM Serif Display). This is only a backup; the real font comes from --font-heading in css/style.css.

signals.name: fontBody
signals.description: Font: the plain font for all other text (Fira Sans). This is only a backup; the real font comes from --font-body in css/style.css.

signals.name: colorPetDogsLight
signals.description: Colour: the palest shade of the colour for dogs (amber). This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-pet-dogs-light in css/style.css.

signals.name: colorPetDogsDark
signals.description: Colour: the darkest shade of the colour for dogs (amber). This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-pet-dogs-dark in css/style.css.

signals.name: width
signals.description: Measured by the loader; small-screen charts keep a compact minimum width.

signals.name: narrow
signals.description: True below 540 pixels. Not used by any part of this map at present.

signals.name: plotHeight
signals.description: Identical viewport height to the symbol map beside it, so places line up.

signals.name: height
signals.description: The map's height. The colour key below the map adds its own room on top of this.

signals.name: breaks
signals.description: The boundaries between the five species-specific rate classes, per 1,000 residents.

signals.name: cameraLon
signals.description: Longitude at the centre of the shared map view.

signals.name: cameraLat
signals.description: Latitude at the centre of the shared map view.

signals.name: cameraSpan
signals.description: Vertical extent of the shared view, initially over the settled south.

signals.name: colorPetDogsMidLight
signals.description: Second dog-rate class; the theme reads --color-pet-dogs-mid-light.

signals.name: colorPetDogsMidDark
signals.description: Fourth dog-rate class; the theme reads --color-pet-dogs-mid-dark.

signals.name: species
signals.description: Dog or Cat: set by the page's Dogs/Cats buttons, shared with the proportional-symbol map beside this one.

signals.name: speciesWord
signals.description: Plural name for the legend and tooltips.

signals.name: region
signals.description: Named camera region: south, metro, all or council; shared page controls set it.

signals.name: selectedCouncil
signals.description: Council code selected in the shared HTML dropdown; also works without hover.

signals.name: zoom
signals.description: User zoom. Only Shift+wheel zooms, allowing normal page scrolling.

signals.name: pan
signals.description: Pixel offset from the current regional camera; linked with the proportional-symbol map.

signals.name: dragStart
signals.description: Record the initial pointer and pan positions to avoid cumulative drag error.

signals.name: hoverCode
signals.description: Transient council code copied to the proportional-symbol map and the density scatterplot.

signals.name: focusCode
signals.description: Pinned selection takes precedence over hover and the page-control selection.

signals.name: colorPetCats
signals.description: Colour: the colour for cats (plum). This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-pet-cats in css/style.css.

signals.name: colorPetCatsLight
signals.description: Colour: the palest shade of the colour for cats (plum). This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-pet-cats-light in css/style.css.

signals.name: colorPetCatsDark
signals.description: Colour: the darkest shade of the colour for cats (plum). This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-pet-cats-dark in css/style.css.

signals.name: colorHeading
signals.description: Colour: the dark blue colour of chart titles. This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-heading in css/style.css.

signals.name: colorPetCatsMidLight
signals.description: Theme colour supplied by css/style.css through the shared loader.

signals.name: colorPetCatsMidDark
signals.description: Theme colour supplied by css/style.css through the shared loader.

signals.name: colorMapWater
signals.description: Theme colour supplied by css/style.css through the shared loader.

signals.name: colorAccent
signals.description: Hover and selection outline colour supplied by --color-accent in css/style.css.

signals.name: pinnedKey
signals.description: Main-mark selection pinned by a click. Empty chart space clears it; the loader preserves it across responsive redraws.

data.name: rates
data.description: Selected-species totals, residents and rates for all 68 councils.

transform.description: Select the same species as the adjacent proportional-symbol map.
Turn the council code into text, so it matches the code in the shapes file.

data.name: councils
data.description: Council shapes with selected-species totals and rates attached.

transform.description: Turn each shape's council code into text, so it matches the numbers file.
Tidy the council name by removing " (SA)" from the end.
Match each shape to its numbers by council code and copy across the animals recorded, the rate per 1,000 residents and residents.
Mark whether each council is one of the 18 in Greater Adelaide (listed by name). Not used by any part of this map at present.
transform.expr: indexof(['Adelaide', 'Burnside', 'Campbelltown (SA)', 'Charles Sturt', 'Gawler', 'Holdfast Bay', 'Marion', 'Mitcham', 'Norwood Payneham and St Peters', 'Onkaparinga', 'Playford', 'Port Adelaide Enfield', 'Prospect', 'Salisbury', 'Tea Tree Gully', 'Unley', 'Walkerville', 'West Torrens'], datum.properties.lga_name_2025) >= 0

data.name: points

transform.description: Sort the councils from most animals to fewest.

data.description: Councils with a record, most animals first. Not used by any part of this map at present.

data.name: mappedCouncils
data.description: Draw the 68 councils with an animal record; other geometries are outside dataset coverage.

transform.description: Exclude unincorporated and non-municipal geometries rather than imply an observed zero.

range.signal: species === 'Dog' ? [colorPetDogsLight, colorPetDogsMidLight, colorPetDogs, colorPetDogsMidDark, colorPetDogsDark] : [colorPetCatsLight, colorPetCatsMidLight, colorPetCats, colorPetCatsMidDark, colorPetCatsDark]

marks.description: The map box: a pale background, with anything outside the box cut off.

marks.name: councilAreas
marks.description: Council areas use the selected species rate classes; hover and selection link to the symbol map and scatterplot.

tooltip.signal: {'Council': datum.name, 'Pet type': speciesWord, 'Recorded at home': format(datum.animals, ',.0f'), 'Residents': format(datum.residents, ',.0f'), 'Recorded animals per 1,000 residents': format(datum.rate, '.1f')}

text.signal: datum.value < breaks[0] ? 'Under ' + breaks[0] : datum.value < breaks[1] ? breaks[0] + ' to ' + (breaks[1] - 1) : datum.value < breaks[2] ? breaks[1] + ' to ' + (breaks[2] - 1) : datum.value < breaks[3] ? breaks[2] + ' to ' + (breaks[3] - 1) : breaks[3] + ' or more'

usermeta.camera: Conic equal-area; same projection, centre, span and viewport height as the symbol map.

scales.rateColour: Five fixed classes: dog boundaries at 100, 200, 300 and 400; cat boundaries at 25, 50, 75 and 100 animals per 1,000 residents. Pet ramps come from the stylesheet.

usermeta.codeGuide: Signals set the responsive layout and theme. Data transforms derive values; scales map them to positions and colours; marks draw the chart.

projections.map: Conic equal-area projection. The camera signals (cameraLon, cameraLat, cameraSpan) choose the visible area.

usermeta.clickSelection: story-interactions.js pins a main-mark selection in pinnedKey and clears it on an empty-space click. Species hues, quantitative colours, symbol areas and plotted positions retain their meanings.
